MQTT broker 的域名或 IP，四個選項都免費、允許匿名、不必註冊（20: Domain name or IP of the MQTT broker. All four options are free, allow anonymous access and need no registration (all four verified on real hardware 2026-08-07: the module reached TCP 1883 on every one). The default, mqttgo.io, is hosted in Taiwan and gives Taiwanese users the lowest latency. ⚠ These are fully public brokers — anyone can subscribe to the topics you publish, and other people's messages may show up in yours. Never send real data while testing; this tool already appends a random suffix to both the topic and the client ID, and draws a new one on every reload. TLS ports: 8883 for mqttgo.io and the rest (mosquitto's CA-free port is 8886).
MQTT 用戶端識別字串。預設值的隨機尾碼是本頁載入時產生的，重新整理就會換一組: MQTT client identifier. The random suffix in the default value is generated when this page loads and changes on every reload — a fixed value is deliberately avoided, because on a public broker a duplicate client ID gets the earlier connection kicked off.
要訂閱的 MQTT 主題，可用萬用字元（+ 單層、# 多層）。預設主題帶隨機尾碼: The MQTT topic to subscribe to; wildcards are allowed (+ for one level, # for many). The default topic carries a random suffix so that you do not pick up other people's messages on a public broker — with a fixed topic your self-loopback check may receive something you did not send, which makes the check worthless.
要發布到的 MQTT 主題。預設帶的隨機尾碼與 Subscribe 那顆按鈕是同: The MQTT topic to publish to. The random suffix in the default is the same one used by the Subscribe button — if you want the self-loopback check to work, do not change only one side.
